profile.name: Umang Sutarsandhiya
profile.headline: Computer Engineer building for the web, learning from data.
profile.intro: I finished my B.E. in Computer Engineering at Gujarat Technological University in 2026. I build responsive websites with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, work with MySQL, and I spent a month at IBM SkillsBuild pulling answers out of Excel and SQL. I am currently learning Python and looking for a full-time role in web development or data analysis.
profile.location: Jepar, Ta. Chuda, Dist. Surendranagar, Gujarat

education.note: Four years of core computer engineering with a final-year focus on web development.

projects.title: Personal portfolio website
projects.summary: A responsive single-page portfolio that puts my work, education and contact details in front of a recruiter in under a minute.
points: Built the full layout in HTML, CSS and JavaScript with no framework, so the page loads fast on a phone.
Sections for about, projects, skills, resume and contact, each reachable from a fixed navigation bar.
Linked GitHub, LinkedIn and a downloadable resume so anyone reading it can verify the work.

projects.title: E-commerce website
projects.summary: A shopping site where customers browse a product catalogue, filter it, fill a cart and place an order against a MySQL database.
points: Modelled products, categories, carts and orders in MySQL and connected them to the front end.
Added category browsing, keyword search and product filtering to shorten the path to a product.
Handled cart updates and order placement, with the layout adapting from desktop down to mobile.
Cleaned and analysed datasets in Excel, using pivot tables and formulas to summarise them.
Wrote SQL queries to join tables and answer questions the raw data did not answer directly.
Presented findings as simple charts that a non-technical reader could follow.

beyondWork.title: Softball, national level
beyondWork.body: I played softball for Gujarat Technological University and earned a national level certificate. Learning the game taught me the fundamentals first, then strategy, and above all how a team wins together. The same habits carry into how I work on a project.
